name: nmap

commands.name: quick
commands.description: Performs a fast top-ports scan to quickly identify common open services

commands.name: full
commands.description: Performs a full TCP port scan on all ports (noisy and potentially detectable)

commands.name: service
commands.description: Enumerates services and versions on open ports using default scripts

commands.name: udp
commands.description: Scans common UDP ports to identify exposed UDP services (slow and unreliable by nature)

commands.name: aggressive
commands.description: Runs an aggressive scan enabling OS detection, version detection, scripts, and traceroute

description: Scans hosts or networks with the nmap scanner tool
usage: Update the target IP and run a scan against it.
